_doc: MRIS barometer + tripwire config (ORDER-073 Phase-2 macro layer). Tripwires are RELATIVE rules (vs SMA200 / ATR-drop), NOT hardcoded price levels. 'user_pin' is an OPTIONAL absolute line the user sets by hand via the MRIS session (e.g. AUDJPY 110); leaving it null = pure relative mode. Every threshold here is user-tunable. Signal convention: +2..-2 where POSITIVE = risk-ON pressure, NEGATIVE = risk-OFF pressure.
_locked: Thresholds LOCKED as user-sanctioned defaults 2026-07-17. Every value below is still a plain tunable number - change it and re-run mris_run.ps1; nothing is hardcoded in the scripts. See _tuning_guide for what each knob does and the sweep-derived alternatives.

_tuning_guide.AUDJPY.user_pin: 110 = the AUD/JPY north-star line (article). null = pure relative (SMA200/ATR) mode with no pin flag.
_tuning_guide.AUDJPY.pin_warn_band_pct: 3.0 = early-warn band above the pin. NOTE: at spot ~113.3 the flag flickers on/off right at the 3% edge; set 4.0-5.0 for a steadier whisper that survives a single up-day.
_tuning_guide.VIX.calm_below/elevated_above/stress_abo: 15/20/30 standard. Looser 17/22/32 would read ~16-18 VIX as calm (risk-on); tighter 13/18/28 warns earlier. stress_above also drives the STRESS override.
_tuning_guide.US10Y_JP10Y.narrowing_5d_bps: 15 ~= 1 ATR of the 10Y yield's 5d move. 10 = more sensitive to carry-fuel change, 20 = only large rate moves trip it.
_tuning_guide.USDJPY.extreme_weak_level: 158 = LOADED_FUSE crowded-carry line. 155 keeps the flag lit across the whole weak-yen band (155-162); 160 only flags the very extreme.
_tuning_guide.XAUUSD.comove_vix_min_pct: 10.0 = min VIX 5d rise (%) for a gold up-move to count as a risk-off co-move (not USD/structural). Lower = more sensitive.
_tuning_guide.regime_thresholds: RI state bands 0.50 / -0.25 / -1.00 (risk_on / neutral floor / risk_off floor); vix_stress_override 30. Widen the neutral band to reduce state churn.

regime_thresholds._doc: Risk Index (RI) = weighted mean of barometer signals in [-2,+2]. State bands:

confidence._doc: confidence = fraction of active barometers whose signal sign agrees with RI sign ('parallel warning lines' from the article). >=0.75 HIGH, >=0.5 MED, else LOW.

barometers.role: carry / risk-appetite pulse (article north-star: leads risk-off)
BOJ / US-JP rate-diff / carry fuel; danger = sharp reversal DOWN (JPY repatriation)
gold - risk-off hedge ONLY when co-moving up with a MEANINGFUL VIX rise; else structural/USD-driven

carry fuel: rate spread; narrowing = carry less attractive. FED via Yahoo ^TNX (US10Y) as spread proxy - JP10Y has no free headless daily source and is BOJ-pinned ~1%, so the 5d spread move is ~entirely the US leg (user decision 2026-07-17).
China / commodity growth. FED via Yahoo HG=F (COMEX copper front future).
